source: Evergreen picks only, from Visit Rapid City's winter attractions list (Nov 2026); restaurant and bar picks still to add

spots.name: Main Street Square
spots.blurb: Downtown plaza with a winter ice rink ($10 day pass)
spots.blurbEs: Plaza del centro con pista de hielo en invierno (pase de día $10)

spots.name: City of Presidents
spots.blurb: Bronze statues of U.S. presidents on downtown corners
spots.blurbEs: Estatuas de bronce de los presidentes de EE. UU. en las esquinas del centro

spots.blurb: Free downtown art galleries and a panoramic Western mural
spots.blurbEs: Galerías de arte gratuitas en el centro y un mural panorámico del Oeste

spots.name: The Journey Museum
spots.blurb: Black Hills history from geology to Lakota culture and pioneers
spots.blurbEs: La historia de Black Hills, de la geología a la cultura lakota y los pioneros

spots.name: Museum of Geology
spots.blurb: Dinosaur fossils and minerals at the South Dakota School of Mines
spots.blurbEs: Fósiles de dinosaurios y minerales en la South Dakota School of Mines
